title: This day of October 2013
columns:
Proxy
I/We
Share A/c No.
of (address)
being a member(s) of East African Breweries Limited, hereby appoint
or failing him the duly appointed Chairman of the meeting to be my/our proxy, to vote on my/our behalf at
the 91st Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held on 31 October 2013 at 11.00 a.m. or at any
adjournment thereof.
As witness to my/our hands
This day of October 2013
Signature(s)
Notes:
1. This Form of Proxy should be completed and returned to the Company’s Registered Office not later than
2:30pm on 30 October 2013.
2. If the appointer is a corporation, this Form of Proxy must be under its Common Seal or under the hand
of the officer or attorney duly authorised in that behalf.
